# vMLX 1.6.60

This release improves GLM-5.3 Flash prefill and persistent caching, preserves reasoning during multimodal tool continuations, and corrects Responses finalization.

## Changes

- **Qualified GLM prefill improvement.** By default, M5 Max systems running MLX 0.32.2 with one active sequence use the qualified exact reduction, subject to operand and launch-safety checks; explicit opt-outs are preserved. Three matched pairs with a 4,305-token input improved median prefill from 332 to 426 tokens/s, about 28.5%. Other hardware, runtime versions and batch configurations retain their existing default path. Experimental decode optimizations remain off by default; this is not a decode-speed or all-context guarantee.
- **Native GLM SSD checkpoints.** Eligible GLM multimodal-runtime sessions select typed native SSD caching automatically when prefix and SSD caching are enabled, paged RAM caching is disabled, and only one sequence is active. Checkpoints preserve native recurrent and attention state, bind image/video identity, and support durable tool continuations and reuse after restart. Adding new media may require a fresh prefill. Saved SSD Off, cache-root and size choices are preserved. Force Text Only retains its separate typed text-cache route.
- **Reasoning preservation.** Preserve assistant reasoning through multimodal message normalization before the model's native chat template decides which history to retain. This corrects lost current-chain reasoning during tool-result continuation without changing the model's reasoning policy or silently modifying tool arguments.
- **Consistent Responses text.** Text already streamed before a tool call is retained in the text, content-part, output-item and completed response fields, including top-level `output_text`.
- **Accurate tool-loop diagnostics.** Distinguish an iteration limit, an attempted direct-answer recovery, and early termination when a tool loop ends without a visible answer.
- **Memory and runtime corrections.** Correct native KDA/MLA cache-memory admission, release retained convolution prefill buffers, and guard affected MLX sorted expert operations against large-row corruption while preserving quantization metadata and reference arithmetic.
- **Clearer cache and memory controls.** Display the actual native cache backend and selection, include native SSD usage in capacity notices, and support guarded Clear SSD Cache. Metal-memory notices use measured pressure, provide applicable copyable guidance, and allow per-model dismissal. System memory limits are not changed automatically.

## Known limits

GLM video-perception errors and model-generated invalid tool inputs remain unresolved. Some MCP validation errors still give the model a generic error while the UI displays the detailed rejection. Cache and transport checks do not establish video-understanding quality or reliable argument generation for every model. Independent-provider native Responses qualification remains incomplete.
